description: Set the clove, and left Gib where he was.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Told him to sit, and kept Sir John off his text.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: On the Holinshed. Nobody moved him.
name: Gib

description: Sat in his pew. He did not turn, and he did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Said fourteenthly, and would not write the sermon out.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Lost the head of the sermon, and said he had come because it was Sunday.
name: William Shakespeare
